capabilities: Sync articles from the SyncRead app into the vault
Configure the SyncRead API key in plugin settings
Trigger synchronization from a ribbon button
disambiguation: Not a vault-sync tool; it imports articles from the SyncRead read-it-later app.
extras: README is very short and inconsistently refers to the plugin as 'lightread-sync-assistant'; the SyncRead app is linked via an App Store link.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull saved articles and reading annotations from the SyncRead read-it-later service.

relations.evidence: a read it later app like omnivore

summary: Syncs articles and their annotations from the SyncRead read-it-later app into an Obsidian vault.
